q0.rule: If no concrete solution at cutoff stop and preserve gaps; implementation and tests require separate confirmation

official_sources.title: OpenProcess
official_sources.supports: Open local process by PID; noninheritable handle; access check and NULL/GetLastError
official_sources.limit: No guarantee requested rights succeed

official_sources.title: Process Security and Access Rights
official_sources.supports: Minimum proposed rights 0x00100000 | 0x1000 = 0x00101000
official_sources.limit: No all-access, debug privilege or elevation proposed

official_sources.title: GetProcessId
official_sources.supports: PID from handle; limited-query permitted
official_sources.limit: PID uniqueness only until termination

official_sources.title: GetProcessTimes
official_sources.supports: Creation FILETIME from handle; limited-query permitted
official_sources.limit: API success required; pre-exit exit-time undefined; no CPU measurement proposed

official_sources.title: FILETIME
official_sources.supports: 64-bit timestamp in 100 ns units since 1601 UTC
official_sources.limit: Representation unit is not actual resolution or global uniqueness

official_sources.title: WaitForSingleObject
official_sources.supports: Zero or finite wait; WAIT_OBJECT_0 signaled; WAIT_FAILED needs error
official_sources.limit: Windows8+ low-power excluded from timeout; closing while waiting undefined

official_sources.title: GetExitCodeProcess
official_sources.supports: BOOL API status separate from DWORD exit; query after signal
official_sources.limit: STILL_ACTIVE259 not liveness test; signaled259 retained then rejected by scenario

official_sources.title: Process Handles and Identifiers
official_sources.supports: Opened handle remains valid until close even after process termination
official_sources.limit: Do not reopen by old PID; self pseudo handle not transferable

official_sources.title: Terminating a Process
official_sources.supports: Exit status set and process object signaled; externally held object persists
official_sources.limit: Parent termination does not automatically terminate descendants

official_sources.title: CloseHandle
official_sources.supports: Close successful real handle once through one owner
official_sources.limit: Closing does not terminate target; no double-close or pending wait close

official_sources.title: Kernel Objects
official_sources.supports: Handle belongs to holder process
official_sources.limit: Serialized handle number is not restartable observation proof

official_sources.title: NtQuerySystemInformation
official_sources.supports: Public time-of-day layout is opaque Reserved1[48]; internal API subject to change
official_sources.limit: Does not publicly guarantee numeric class3 or first8bytes BootTime

official_sources.title: psutil FILETIME conversion
official_sources.supports: Integer combine and integer epoch subtraction before double conversion and division
official_sources.limit: Tag source is not installed native-binary provenance

official_sources.title: psutil Windows process primitives
official_sources.supports: GetProcessTimes creation path; Toolhelp parent PID map
official_sources.limit: Parent snapshot is non-atomic evidence of chain

official_sources.title: psutil process-info fallback
official_sources.supports: SystemProcessInformation CreateTime uses same LargeInteger conversion
official_sources.limit: Fallback remains source interpretation, no runtime probe

official_sources.title: psutil Windows Python wrapper
official_sources.supports: Permission fallback for create time; process wait may have no exit code
official_sources.limit: Do not use late wait/PID disappearance to fill exact role code

official_sources.title: psutil Process identity and ancestry
official_sources.supports: Windows ppid cached; parent checks new child time and parent<=child
official_sources.limit: Fresh objects/snapshots required for pre-ack recheck; no atomic ancestry guarantee

official_sources.title: CPython venvlauncher project
official_sources.supports: venv launcher compiles redirect variant of PC/launcher.c
official_sources.limit: Does not prove exact V77 executables

official_sources.title: CPython launcher implementation
official_sources.supports: Can create child, wait and relay its exit code
official_sources.limit: Plausible launcher mechanism only; not historical role exit proof

official_sources.title: CPython path initialization
official_sources.supports: Environment launcher path can affect executable path
official_sources.limit: sys.executable string does not prove identical OS PID

candidate.identity: keep CP exact three fields; external ready binds raw creation and identity descriptor
candidate.raw_creation_serialization: canonical unsigned decimal string, no sign/leading zeros/float; reject outside uint64 or before Unix epoch
candidate.exit_condition: same held handle WAIT_OBJECT_0 then successful GetExitCodeProcess
candidate.exit_type: exact Python int normalized from DWORD, never bool/float/string
candidate.boot_contract: frozen CP compatibility only; private layout not official stable boot identifier
candidate.fallback: none; missing/uncertain role proof fails closed
